## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ is a diagrammatic-tabular exposition of the relations between Fǎzàng's *Five Teachings* doxography and the doctrines of *duàn* 斷 (cutting-off of defilements), *zhèng* 證 (verifying/realising), and *sān jué* 三覺 (the three awakenings). The *jiǎn làn tú* "diagram for selecting from the confused" format is intended to provide systematic clarity through visual-tabular presentation of doctrinal relations.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1660 – 1715) reflects [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ's mature scholarly activity. The work is part of his late-imperial Huáyán-school doctrinal-publishing project. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1026) collection.
